A senator’s name is the Senate record’s first_name and last_name joined by one space, checked against vote 618 (SHA-256 prefix ab81bac6e53d98c8); the record carries no accents (Ben Lujan as printed), and the space the record leaves after three first names (Curtis, Risch, Schmitt) is not doubled.
